headline: Ethiopia, Djibouti, and Somalia secure €20 million EU partnership for regional trade corridors
summary: Ethiopia, Djibouti and Somalia secured a €20 million partnership with the European Union to improve green transport, digital trade and regional connectivity. The deal was signed with TradeMark Africa at the 2026 Africa Trade and Development Forum in Addis Ababa.
why: Trade corridors and transport links shape the cost of moving goods through the Horn of Africa, which affects regional importers, exporters and logistics operators.
